extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as b38884f538ae872f79eb9a5180b78a35f02a329a9547d95a2e88620f92d1355c; the supplied identity is LCSC C18199168, MPN SS58, manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The datasheet identity is SS52 THRU SS520 SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER, Rev:1.0, three pages; the SS58 row and grouped curves were examined.

Fig. 3 groups SS58-SS510 on the short-dashed typical forward-voltage curve. The ten points are direct observations from the supplied vector plot at the labeled 0.1 V grid values from 0.4 V through 1.3 V; no intermediate points were synthesized or interpolated.

Fig. 4 groups SS58-SS520 on the dashed reverse-characteristic curves. The six points on each Tj curve are direct observations at 10%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 95% of rated peak reverse voltage; reverse current is represented as the positive magnitude shown on the mA logarithmic axis, with no intermediate points synthesized or interpolated.

The SS58 electrical-characteristics row gives maximum VF = 0.70 V at IF = 5.0 A, maximum IR1 = 0.05 mA at VR = VDC = 80 V and Ta = 25 degC, separate maximum IR2 = 5 mA at Ta = 100 degC, and typical CJ = 200 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz. SI conversions are used in specs: 0.05 mA = 5e-5 A and 200 pF = 2e-10 F.

Absolute maximum ratings for SS58 include VRRM = 80 V, VRMS = 56 V, VDC = 80 V, IF(AV) = 5.0 A, and IFSM = 120 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave; these ratings are limits and are not treated as breakdown data. The datasheet gives Tj = -55 to +150 degC and storage temperature = -55 to +150 degC.
The supplied datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification. VRRM and VDC ratings are not substituted for breakdown data.
